updates.how: A new wing design has been achieved by modifying a previous front wing assembly, which has been further optimised to offer more local load whilst maintaining the flow stability.
By modifying existing parts, a larger exit duct has been achieved for more cooling flow to cope with the anticipated brake energy of the Singapore circuit
